capabilities: Render interactive Rubik's Cube visualizations in notes
Rotate cube views with notation that updates to match orientation
Time solves with an integrated speedcubing timer and result table
Customize cube size, hex colors, and arrow paths
extras: Full documentation lives outside the README (an in-plugin 'Insert quick start guide' command and an external docs link); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and several features (F2L support, additional twisty puzzles, persisted timer stats) are listed as planned only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize cube algorithms or time speedcubing practice inside notes.
summary: Rubik's Cube plugin that renders interactive cube visualizations from code blocks and includes a speedcubing training timer.
